title: Bind Vercel AWS OIDC to AWS-Specific Audience

transitions.note: Created after reviewing Vercel custom OIDC audience support introduced in 2026.
Use provider-specific audience sts.amazonaws.com in both runtime token exchange and CloudFormation OIDC trust before any live AWS deployment.

Runtime now requests Vercel OIDC audience sts.amazonaws.com; CloudFormation IAM OIDC client-id and both role trust aud conditions match. cfn-lint passed and unit test asserts audience + region contract.
AWS-specific OIDC audience hardening completed before live AWS deployment. No AWS resource, env, credential, database, route or paid traffic mutation.
Reopened after PR review correctly found that an existing reused OIDC provider could lack the new sts.amazonaws.com client ID.

notes: Completed pre-deployment security hardening. Vercel custom OIDC audience is now provider-specific (sts.amazonaws.com), reducing cross-service token replay risk.
